fact: Forty-seven RCTs were included, with a combined cohort of 23,244 patients.
fact_zh: 纳入了47项随机对照试验，总共有23,244名患者。
quote: Forty-seven RCTs were included, with a combined cohort of 23,244 patients.

fact: GLP-1 RAs demonstrated a mean weight reduction of -4.57 kg (95% CI -5.35 to -3.78) compared with placebo.
fact_zh: GLP-1受体激动剂与安慰剂相比，平均体重减少了4.57公斤（95%置信区间：-5.35至-3.78）。
quote: GLP-1 RAs demonstrated a mean weight reduction of -4.57 kg (95% CI -5.35 to -3.78), mean BMI reduction of -2.07 kg/m2 (95% CI -2.53 to -1.62), and mean waist circumference reduction of -4.55 cm (95% CI -5.72 to -3.38) compared with placebo.

fact: GLP-1 RAs demonstrated a mean BMI reduction of -2.07 kg/m2 (95% CI -2.53 to -1.62) compared with placebo.

quote: GLP-1 RAs demonstrated a mean weight reduction of -4.57 kg (95% CI -5.35 to -3.78), mean BMI reduction of -2.07 kg/m2 (95% CI -2.53 to -1.62), and mean waist circumference reduction of -4.55 cm (95% CI -5.72 to -3.38) compared with placebo.

fact: GLP-1 RAs demonstrated a mean waist circumference reduction of -4.55 cm (95% CI -5.72 to -3.38) compared with placebo.
fact_zh: GLP-1受体激动剂与安慰剂相比，平均腰围减少了4.55厘米（95%置信区间：-5.72至-3.38）。
quote: GLP-1 RAs demonstrated a mean weight reduction of -4.57 kg (95% CI -5.35 to -3.78), mean BMI reduction of -2.07 kg/m2 (95% CI -2.53 to -1.62), and mean waist circumference reduction of -4.55 cm (95% CI -5.72 to -3.38) compared with placebo.

fact: The greatest treatment benefit appeared to favor patients who were younger, female, without diabetes, with higher baseline weight and BMI but lower baseline HbA1c, and treated over a longer duration.
fact_zh: 治疗效果最大的患者群体是年轻、女性、无糖尿病、基线体重和BMI较高但基线HbA1c较低且治疗时间较长的患者。
quote: The greatest treatment benefit appeared to favor patients who were younger, female, without diabetes, with higher baseline weight and BMI but lower baseline HbA1c, and treated over a longer duration.

fact: Limitations include substantial statistical heterogeneity, in part due to broad inclusion criteria.
fact_zh: 局限性包括显著的统计异质性，部分原因是纳入标准较宽。
quote: Limitations include substantial statistical heterogeneity, in part due to broad inclusion criteria.

fact: This meta-analysis included RCTs evaluating the use of GLP-1 RAs for mean differences from baseline in weight, BMI, and waist circumference in adults with obesity or overweight with or without diabetes.
fact_zh: 这项荟萃分析纳入了评估GLP-1受体激动剂对肥胖或超重成人（无论是否患有糖尿病）体重、BMI和腰围基线差异的随机对照试验。
quote: The search was limited to RCTs evaluating the use of GLP-1 RAs for mean differences from baseline in weight, BMI, and waist circumference in adults with obesity or overweight with or without diabetes.

fact: GLP-1 RAs demonstrated significant weight, BMI, and waist circumference reduction benefits in this meta-analysis.
fact_zh: 在此次荟萃分析中，GLP-1受体激动剂显示出显著的体重、BMI和腰围减少的益处。
quote: GLP-1 RAs demonstrated significant weight, BMI, and waist circumference reduction benefits in this meta-analysis.

fact: The search was limited to RCTs evaluating the use of GLP-1 RAs for mean differences from baseline in weight, BMI, and waist circumference in adults with obesity or overweight with or without diabetes.

fact: We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) for RCTs published from inception to 4 October 2024.
fact_zh: 我们系统搜索了PubMed、Embase和Cochrane中央对照试验注册库（CENTRAL），以获取从创刊至2024年10月4日发表的随机对照试验。
quote: We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) for RCTs published from inception to 4 October 2024.
